title: y-sharp ops script (schema 1)
description: Normative step vocabulary of ADR 0011/0016. Both interpreters (tools/fixture-gen and tests/YSharp.TestKit) replay exactly these kinds and fields. Adding a kind needs a change here, an interpreter on each side and a [Covers] entry.

replicaName.description: A replica declared in replicas (checked by the interpreters, not by this schema).

value.description: ADR 0011 tagged value. Plain: null, booleans, finite numbers other than -0, strings without lone surrogates, arrays. Tagged objects carry "$".

schedule.description: Delivery schedule: entries run in order. sv captures a state vector (a SyncStep1 message); reply captures encodeStateAsUpdate(doc, sv) (a SyncStep2 reply); apply delivers a captured reply by name or the index-th update event of another replica to doc. Repeating an apply duplicates a delivery, omitting one drops it, reordering entries reorders delivery.

oneOf.title: applyForeign
oneOf.description: Apply bytes another implementation produced to a replica (ADR 0012). Origin is the string "foreign". Without name a rejected update is a script error; with name the outcome is recorded under results as {accepted}, plus readPastEnd: true when an accepted update was only decodable because a reader returned its default past the end of a buffer, or zeroLengthDeleteRange: true when an accepted update holds a zero-length delete range (ENC-51), unsortedPendingDeleteSet: true when accepted delete ranges parked as pending state were out of order (ENC-86), or selfDependentPending: true when a parked struct depends on itself (Q15).
